item.title: Field-level options
item.description:
Field-level options

Use this page when you want to validate a field by declaring options next to it in a .proto file.

Choose an option 

  • Require a value to be present: (required), customize with (if_missing).error_msg
  • Enforce a numeric boundary: (min), (max), or (range)
  • Enforce a string format: (pattern).regex
  • Validate a nested message: (validate) = true
  • Require another field when this one is set: (goes).with = "other_field"
  • Prevent reassignment: (set_once) = true, customize with (if_set_again).error_msg

For canonical definitions, see spine/options.proto.

item.title: Options for `oneof` fields
item.description:
Options for oneof fields

Use this page when you have a oneof group and want to enforce that one of its cases is set.

For canonical definitions, see spine/options.proto.

Required selection: (choice) 

Use (choice).required = true on a oneof group to require selecting one of its fields.

Applies to

  • oneof groups (declared on the oneof itself, not on a field inside it).

Minimal example

item.title: Message-level options
item.description:
Message-level options

Use this page when message validity depends on multiple fields together, such as:

  • “At least one of these fields must be set.”
  • “Either this group of fields is set, or that group is set.”

For canonical definitions, see spine/options.proto.

Field group requirements: (require) 

Use option (require).fields on a message to declare alternative groups of required fields.

How to write the expression

item.title: Options for `repeated` and `map` fields
item.description:
Options for repeated and map fields

Use this page when you want to validate collections declared as repeated fields or map fields.

Choose an option 

  • Require a collection to be non-empty: (required) = true
  • Enforce uniqueness: (distinct) = true, customize with (if_has_duplicates).error_msg
  • Validate nested message elements/values: (validate) = true
  • Enforce numeric constraints per element: (min), (max), (range)
  • Enforce a pattern per element: (pattern).regex
  • Require a companion field when the collection is present: (goes).with = "other_field"

For canonical definitions, see spine/options.proto.
